scope: Computer Control Phase 9B3B native file picker navigation and selection
platform: macOS Cocoa/AppKit NSOpenPanel via Provider registry and native Accessibility

safetyBoundary.addressing: registered application Providers and exact currently visible picker item names only
safetyBoundary.postcondition: selection requires fresh selected=true observation; directory navigation requires picker remains open with changed visible location
safetyBoundary.cleanup: physical harness may stop only its temporary test-owned fixture process

expectedCoverage: filePicker.selectItem and filePicker.openDirectory remain IMPLEMENTED until this session passes
a real NSOpenPanel opens on PickerRoot
Alpha.txt is selected through native AX semantics and independently observed selected=true
openDirectory rejects Alpha.txt before native mutation because it is a file
the rejected file-as-directory operation preserves the open picker and PickerRoot location
FolderA is opened using native AX confirmation after exact semantic rebind
success requires a changed visible location while the picker remains open
the new location is FolderA and Nested.txt becomes visibly observable
no picker accept/cancel, arbitrary path, filesystem mutation, coordinate or keyboard fallback is used
